parameters.source: OBR November 2025 Economic and Fiscal Outlook

baseline.label: Current system (threshold frozen)
baseline.description: Threshold frozen at £29,385 from 2027, interest RPI + 0–3%

cancel_freeze.label: Cancel the threshold freeze
cancel_freeze.description: Uprate threshold annually with average earnings growth (OBR forecasts)

interest_cap_rpi.label: Cap interest at RPI
interest_cap_rpi.description: Cap the interest rate at RPI (0% margin), as proposed by the Conservative Party
